summary: A complete photometric catalog, reduced from all available SPAM, MINERVA, and CEERS filters, is hosted on the SPAM catalog website below. This includes photometric redshifts and associated templates.
citation_request: If you use SPAM team products, the catalogs, the photometric redshifts, or the reduced images below, please cite:

citations.text: Larson & Davis et al. 2026, in prep

specz.title: Spectroscopic Redshift Catalog
specz.description: This spectroscopic redshift catalog includes columns for the SPAM ID, RA, DEC, photometric redshift (ZA), photometric redshift errors (ZL68, ZU68, ZL95, ZU95), spectroscopic redshift (ZSPEC), and spectroscopic redshift grade (ZSPEC_VETTED, where robust = 2). Redshifts come from a variety of datasets as described in the SPAM overview paper. If you use this catalog, please cite Larson & Davis et al. 2026.
